boundaries.reason: Existing handlers and domain error types expose natural-language detail/message while clients migrate to descriptors.
boundaries.telemetry: Exact AST-fingerprint baseline reports remaining public natural-language error sites and fails additions.
boundaries.rollback_boundary: Registered descriptors are additive; old fields remain deprecated projections until the compatibility gate closes.
removal_conditions: All public product errors resolve through the registry.
No raw exception or provider message reaches a product/public field.
Legacy projection reads are zero for the declared compatibility window.

boundaries.reason: Existing consumers read text and status_text fields from stored or streamed events.
boundaries.telemetry: Versioned boundary-level counts only; event codes and raw text are excluded.
boundaries.rollback_boundary: Stable code/params and deprecated text projections are dual-written during the compatibility window.
removal_conditions: All first-party consumers localize event code/params.
Replays and retries retain descriptor and language snapshots.
Legacy text projection reads are zero.

boundaries.reason: Old persisted data and clients have no language snapshot.
boundaries.telemetry: Versioned process-local count for the exact fallback boundary; no ingress, entity, locale payload or business content.
boundaries.rollback_boundary: LanguageContext columns and JSON snapshots are additive and remain readable when enforcement is disabled.
removal_conditions: Every active ingress writes a normalized immutable snapshot.
No new empty snapshot is written.
Legacy-default use is zero for the retention window.

boundaries.reason: Public API v1 clients may still read detail, message, text, or status_text.
boundaries.telemetry: Versioned process-local count for the exact projection boundary; no code params, raw cause, field values or business content.
boundaries.rollback_boundary: The stable descriptor is canonical; compatibility fields are generated only from registered safe defaults, never internal causes.
removal_conditions: The documented client compatibility window has ended.
First-party and observed legacy reads are zero.
Unknown-code safe fallback tests remain green without the projections.

boundaries.reason: Old rows encoded team, scheduled-task, and skill-test machine kinds in product-owned Chinese title prefixes.
boundaries.telemetry: Static fingerprint plus exact migration/read tests guard this boundary; removal audits may count only row IDs and stable/null session kinds, never titles or other business content.
boundaries.rollback_boundary: The session_kind column and index are additive; legacy titles remain byte-for-byte unchanged and the exact read fallback can be restored independently.
removal_conditions: Every supported database has the additive session_kind schema and backfill.
No null-kind row matches an exact legacy title shape during the retention window.
Every first-party writer stores a stable kind without constructing a product-language title prefix.
The exact read fallback and legacy-title migration predicates are removed together.
